name: slack-message-formatter
description: Convert Markdown to rich HTML for pasting into Slack or mrkdwn for webhooks.

interface.shortDescription: Format Slack messages with a browser preview
interface.longDescription: Draft Slack messages, preview rich HTML for manual copy-paste, or convert Markdown to mrkdwn for webhooks. Requires Node.js 20 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Format a release announcement for Slack and open a preview.
